SELECT STATUS, STATUS_CD, #{documentType} as DOCUMENT_TYPE, SUM(cap_dist_cnt) as CAPITAL_DISTRICT, SUM (syr_cnt) as SYRACUSE, SUM (new_roch_cnt) as NEW_ROCHELLE, SUM (long_is_cnt) as LONG_ISLAND, SUM (roch_cnt) as ROCHESTER, SUM( buff_cnt) as BUFFALO, SUM (nyc_cnt ) as NEW_YORK_CITY, SUM (co_cnt) as CENTRAL_OFFICE, SUM(cap_dist_cnt)+ SUM (syr_cnt) + SUM (new_roch_cnt) + SUM (long_is_cnt) + SUM (roch_cnt) + SUM( buff_cnt) + SUM (nyc_cnt )+ SUM ( co_cnt) TOTAL, (case status when 'Open' then 1 when 'Reopened' then 2 when 'Needs assignment' then 3 when 'Reassignment requested' then 4 when 'Pending ACRF review' then 5 when 'Rejected' then 6 else 7 end) as sort_order FROM (select CASE WHEN b.CURRENT_ASSIGNMENT_STATUS NOT IN ('CLOSED','CLS_ADM') THEN s.status_description ELSE s.activity_type_description END STATUS, CASE WHEN b.CURRENT_ASSIGNMENT_STATUS NOT IN ('CLOSED','CLS_ADM') THEN b.CURRENT_ASSIGNMENT_STATUS ELSE s.ACTIVITY_TYPE_CODE END STATUS_CD, (case when b.current_region_cd = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as cap_dist_cnt, (case when b.current_region_cd = '2' then 1 else 0 end) as syr_cnt, (case when b.current_region_cd = '3' then 1 else 0 end) as new_roch_cnt, (case when b.current_region_cd = '4' then 1 else 0 end) as long_is_cnt, (case when b.current_region_cd = '5' then 1 else 0 end) as roch_cnt, (case when b.current_region_cd = '6' then 1 else 0 end) as buff_cnt, (case when b.current_region_cd = '7' then 1 else 0 end) as nyc_cnt, (case when b.current_region_cd = '9' then 1 else 0 end) as co_cnt from ${stdTableName} a, surveillance_assignment b, coded_assignment_status s, coded_activity_type s
where
trim(a.${FileNameReferenceColumn}) = #{fileName}
b.CREATE_DATE between TO_DATE(#{fromDate},'MM/DD/YYYY') and TO_DATE(#{toDate},'MM/DD/YYYY')+1
and a.document_id = b.triggering_doc_id and b.current_assignment_status = s.status_cd and b.current_activity_type_code = s.activity_type_code (+) ) GROUP BY status,status_CD
UNION select 'TOTALS' as status,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,9 as sort_order from dual
UNION select 'WAITING IN THE WINGS' as status, 'WAITING IN THE WINGS', #{documentType} as DOCUMENT_TYPE, null, null, null, null, NULL, null, null, null, count(*) TOTAL, 10 as sort_order from person_doc_association where surv_assess_status = '2' and dissassociation_date is null and document_id in (select a.document_id from ${stdTableName} a where trim(a.${FileNameReferenceColumn}) = #{fileName} )
order by sort_order, status

with main_sql as ( select b.triggering_doc_id, b.document_id, b.stateno, b.current_assignment_status, case when b.current_assignment_status not in ('CLOSED','CLS_ADM') then s.status_description else c.activity_type_description end status, CASE WHEN b.CURRENT_ASSIGNMENT_STATUS NOT IN ('CLOSED','CLS_ADM') THEN b.CURRENT_ASSIGNMENT_STATUS ELSE c.ACTIVITY_TYPE_CODE END STATUS_CD
from ${stdTableName} a, surveillance_assignment b, coded_assignment_status s, coded_activity_type c, document_locator doc_loc where
trim(${FileNameReferenceColumn}) = #{fileName}
b.CREATE_DATE between TO_DATE(#{fromDate},'MM/DD/YYYY') and TO_DATE(#{toDate},'MM/DD/YYYY')+1
and doc_loc.document_id = b. triggering_doc_id
AND doc_loc.TEST_TYPE_CD = #{testType}
and a.document_id = b.triggering_doc_id and b.current_assignment_status = s.status_cd and b.current_activity_type_code = c.activity_type_code (+) )
select status, STATUS_CD, #{documentType} as DOCUMENT_TYPE, sum(case when hiv_aids_cdc is null and hiv_cdc is null and aids_cdc is null then 1 else 0 end) as NOT_IN_EHARS_CNT, sum(case when (hiv_aids_cdc = 'N' and hiv_cdc = 'N' and aids_cdc = 'N') or (hiv_aids_cdc = 'N' and hiv_cdc is null and aids_cdc is null) or (hiv_aids_cdc is null and hiv_cdc = 'N' and aids_cdc = 'N') then 1 else 0 end) as DOES_NOT_MCD_CNT, sum(case when (hiv_aids_cdc = 'Y' or hiv_cdc = 'Y' or aids_cdc = 'Y') and (d_hiv_aids_cdc_elig is null or d_hiv_aids_cdc_elig = 'N') and (e_hiv_aids_cdc_elig is null or e_hiv_aids_cdc_elig = 'N') then 1 else 0 end) as MCD_NOT_ELIG_CNT, sum(case when d_hiv_aids_cdc_elig = 'Y' or e_hiv_aids_cdc_elig = 'Y' then 1 else 0 end) as ELIG_CNT, count(*) as TOTAL, (case status when 'Open' then 1 when 'Reopened' then 2 when 'Needs assignment' then 3 when 'Reassignment requested' then 4 when 'Pending ACRF review' then 5 when 'Rejected' then 6 else 7 end) as sort_order from (select m.status, m.STATUS_CD, d.hiv_aids_cdc, e.hiv_cdc, e.aids_cdc, /* case def */ d.hiv_aids_cdc_elig as d_hiv_aids_cdc_elig, e.hiv_aids_cdc_elig as e_hiv_aids_cdc_elig, /* eligibility */ row_number() over (partition by m.stateno, m.document_id order by m.stateno, m.document_id) as rwnum from main_sql m, ehars_person_nyc d, nyehms_ehars_stateno_map e where m.stateno = d.nyehms_stateno(+) and m.stateno = e.nyehms_stateno(+) ) where rwnum=1 group by status, STATUS_CD UNION select 'TOTALS' as status,null, null,null,null,null,null,count(*),9 as sort_order from dual
UNION select 'WAITING IN THE WINGS' as status, 'WAITING IN THE WINGS',#{documentType} as DOCUMENT_TYPE, null,null,null,null,count(*),10 as sort_order from person_doc_association where surv_assess_status = '2' and dissassociation_date is null and document_id in (select a.document_id from ${stdTableName} a where trim(a.${FileNameReferenceColumn}) = #{fileName} )
order by sort_order, status

SELECT S.stateno,PKG_TRK_COMMON.fn_get_fullname(U.LAST_NAME ,U.FIRST_NAME ,U.MIDDLE_NAME , NULL) WORKER_NAME, CASE WHEN s.CURRENT_ASSIGNMENT_STATUS NOT IN ('CLOSED','CLS_ADM') THEN coded_assignment_status.status_description ELSE coded_activity_type.activity_type_description END ASSIGNMENT_STATUS,
case when d.hiv_aids_cdc is null and e.hiv_cdc is null and e.aids_cdc is null then 'Not In eHARS' when (d.hiv_aids_cdc = 'N' and e.hiv_cdc = 'N' and e.aids_cdc = 'N') or (d.hiv_aids_cdc = 'N' and e.hiv_cdc is null and e.aids_cdc is null) or (d.hiv_aids_cdc is null and e.hiv_cdc = 'N' and e.aids_cdc = 'N') then 'Does Not Meet Case Definition' when (d.hiv_aids_cdc = 'Y' or e.hiv_cdc = 'Y' or e.aids_cdc = 'Y') and (d.hiv_aids_cdc_elig is null or d.hiv_aids_cdc_elig = 'N') and (d.hiv_aids_cdc_elig is null or e.hiv_aids_cdc_elig = 'N') then 'Meets Case Definition Does Not Meet Eligibility' when d.hiv_aids_cdc_elig = 'Y' or e.hiv_aids_cdc_elig = 'Y' then 'Meets Case Definition Meets Eligibility' ELSE NULL END CATEGORY_DESCRIPTION
FROM SURVEILLANCE_ASSIGNMENT S , WORKER_ASSIGNMENT W , USER_REGION R ,NYEHMS_USERS U , ehars_person_nyc d, nyehms_ehars_stateno_map e, coded_activity_type coded_activity_type, coded_assignment_status coded_assignment_status,
DOCUMENT_LOCATOR D
where s.triggering_doc_id = d.DOCUMENT_ID and D.DOCUMENT_TYPE_CODE = #{documentType}
AND D.TEST_TYPE_CD = #{testType}
and s.CREATE_DATE between TO_DATE(#{fromDate},'MM/DD/YYYY') and TO_DATE(#{toDate},'MM/DD/YYYY')+1
${stdTableName} std WHERE TRIGGERING_DOC_ID = std.document_id
and std.${FileNameReferenceColumn} = #{fileName}
and s.CREATE_DATE between TO_DATE(#{fromDate},'MM/DD/YYYY') and TO_DATE(#{toDate},'MM/DD/YYYY')+1
and s.current_assignment_status = coded_assignment_status.status_cd(+) AND S.CURRENT_WORKER_ASSIGNMENT_ID = W.WORKER_ASSIGNMENT_ID (+) AND W.WORKER_REGION_ID = R.WORKER_REGION_ID (+) AND R.WORKER_ID = U.worker_id(+) and s.current_activity_type_code = coded_activity_type.activity_type_code (+) AND S.stateno = d.nyehms_stateno(+) AND S.stateno = e.nyehms_stateno(+)
and CURRENT_ASSIGNMENT_STATUS in ('CLOSED', 'CLS_ADM')
and CURRENT_ASSIGNMENT_STATUS = UPPER(#{assignmentStatus})
AND CASE WHEN #{activityTypeCode} IS NULL THEN '1' ELSE #{activityTypeCode} END = CASE WHEN #{activityTypeCode} IS NULL THEN '1' ELSE S.CURRENT_ACTIVITY_TYPE_CODE END
AND case when d.hiv_aids_cdc is null and e.hiv_cdc is null and e.aids_cdc is null then 1 else 0 end =1
AND case when (d.hiv_aids_cdc = 'N' and e.hiv_cdc = 'N' and e.aids_cdc = 'N') or (d.hiv_aids_cdc = 'N' and e.hiv_cdc is null and e.aids_cdc is null) or (d.hiv_aids_cdc is null and e.hiv_cdc = 'N' and e.aids_cdc = 'N') then 1 else 0 end = 1
AND case when (d.hiv_aids_cdc = 'Y' or e.hiv_cdc = 'Y' or e.aids_cdc = 'Y') and (d.hiv_aids_cdc_elig is null or d.hiv_aids_cdc_elig = 'N') and (e.hiv_aids_cdc_elig is null or e.hiv_aids_cdc_elig = 'N') then 1 else 0 end =1
AND case when d.hiv_aids_cdc_elig = 'Y' or e.hiv_aids_cdc_elig = 'Y' then 1 else 0 end = 1

SELECT STATENO from person_doc_association where surv_assess_status = '2' and dissassociation_date is null and document_id in (select a.document_id from ${stdTableName} a, document_locator b where a.document_id = b.document_id and trim(a.${FileNameReferenceColumn}) = #{fileName} and b.is_active = 'Y')

select * from ( select current_region_cd , case when ACTIVITY_TYPE_DESCRIPTION is null then current_assignment_status else ACTIVITY_TYPE_DESCRIPTION end current_status, case when ACTIVITY_TYPE_CODE is null then current_assignment_status else ACTIVITY_TYPE_CODE end current_status_code, case when TEST_TYPE_CD is null then DOCUMENT_TYPE_CODE else TEST_TYPE_CD end doc_type from SURVEILLANCE_ASSIGNMENT surv, --CODED_REGION, CODED_ACTIVITY_TYPE, document_locator doc where
AHI_FLAG = 'Y' and surv.create_date > sysdate-90 and
AHI_FLAG = #{ahiFlag} and
-- and region_code = current_region_cd CURRENT_ACTIVITY_TYPE_CODE = ACTIVITY_TYPE_CODE (+) and TRIGGERING_DOC_ID = doc.document_id ) PIVOT ( COUNT(*) FOR current_region_cd in (1 R1,2 R2,3 R3,4 R4,5 R5,6 R6,7 R7,9 R9)) order by current_status_code, doc_type
